scripts.dev: concurrently "vite" "wget -qO- https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py | python3 - --user && export PATH=$PATH:/root/.local/bin && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && export PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) && python3 -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload"
scripts.start: export PATH=$PATH:/root/.local/bin && export PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) && python3 -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
